description: This source file defines classes, functions, and enums related to gateway configuration and URL parsing in an Android application, including handling setup codes, security validation, and network configuration for gateways.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointConfig
classes.description: Configuration details of a gateway endpoint including host, port, and security info.

classes.name: GatewaySetupCode
classes.description: Contains URL and optional security tokens/password for setting up a gateway.

classes.name: GatewayConnectConfig
classes.description: Configuration used to establish a connection to a gateway, including host, port, security, and tokens.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointValidationError
classes.description: Enum representing errors during gateway URL validation.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointInputSource
classes.description: Enumeration of input sources for gateway endpoint entry such as setup code, manual entry, or QR scan.

classes.name: GatewayEndpointParseResult
classes.description: Result of parsing a gateway endpoint, including config or error.

classes.name: GatewayScannedSetupCodeResult
classes.description: Result of scanning a setup code, either a setup code string or an error.

methods.name: resolveGatewayConnectConfig
methods.description: Generates a GatewayConnectConfig based on user input, setup code, and saved settings.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpoint
methods.description: Parses a raw string into a GatewayEndpointConfig if valid.

methods.name: parseGatewayEndpointResult
methods.description: Parses raw input into a detailed GatewayEndpointParseResult, including error handling.

methods.name: decodeGatewaySetupCode
methods.description: Decodes a base64-encoded setup code into GatewaySetupCode structure.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCode
methods.description: Attempts to extract a setup code from scanned input.

methods.name: resolveScannedSetupCodeResult
methods.description: Returns detailed result (code or error) from scanned setup code input.

methods.name: gatewayEndpointValidationMessage
methods.description: Provides user-facing validation messages based on error and input source.

methods.name: composeGatewayManualUrl
methods.description: Builds a manual URL string from host, port, and TLS flag.
